tabs.title: Important Years
tabs.subtitle: Year → what came in, and why (one line each)

timeline.what: Indian Coinage Act
timeline.why: Coins are issued under it (up to ₹1,000).

timeline.what: Treasury Bills first issued in India
timeline.why: Short-term borrowing for the Central Government.

timeline.what: BIS set up (17 May 1930)
timeline.why: Cooperation among central banks for financial stability.

timeline.what: RBI established (1 April 1934)
timeline.why: Issues currency, banker to Govt and banks (sole note issuer, Sec 22).

timeline.what: Currency Ordinance
timeline.why: ₹1 notes are issued under it (by Govt of India).

timeline.what: RBI nationalised (1 Jan 1949); Banking Regulation Act
timeline.why: Shares moved to Central Govt; BR Act defines banking (Sec 5(b)).

timeline.what: NSIC set up
timeline.why: To promote and grow micro and small enterprises.

timeline.what: NI-MSME set up
timeline.why: Enterprise promotion and entrepreneurship development.

timeline.what: National Credit Council
timeline.why: First step towards priority sector lending.

timeline.what: Priority sector formally described
timeline.why: To direct credit to neglected sectors.

timeline.what: SWIFT founded (Brussels)
timeline.why: Secure worldwide messaging between banks.

timeline.what: Tandon Committee (July); PSL target 33⅓% by 1979
timeline.why: Fix working capital lending (MPBF); raise priority sector share.

timeline.what: Nomination facility (29 Mar 1985); PSL target 40% by Mar 1985
timeline.why: Pay nominees without succession certificate; more credit to priority sector.

timeline.what: CRISIL (first rating agency); Legal Services Authorities Act
timeline.why: Credit ratings in India; Lok Adalats to settle cases without courts.

timeline.what: Basel I
timeline.why: Minimum capital 8% of RWA, focus on credit risk.

timeline.what: Narasimham Committee; Nayak Committee (Dec); ICRA
timeline.why: Financial sector reforms; working capital for small units.
timeline.src: NPA Policy; Fund Based Limits; CIC

timeline.what: Ghosh Committee
timeline.why: Base for banks' compliance processes.

timeline.what: IRACP prudential norms; DRTs set up; CARE
timeline.why: Recognise NPAs properly and speed up recovery.

timeline.what: Supreme Court: HUF cannot be a partner
timeline.why: HUF cannot enter into a partnership.

timeline.what: India adopted Basel I; IRDA Act
timeline.why: Capital adequacy for Indian banks; insurance regulation.

timeline.what: CIBIL incorporated; CGTMSE started (01.08.2000)
timeline.why: Credit information bureau; collateral-free guarantee for MSE loans.

timeline.what: SARFAESI Act; PMLA
timeline.why: Banks can enforce security without courts; fight money laundering.

timeline.what: BPLR introduced; RBI bars 'without recourse' LCs (23 Jan)
timeline.why: Bring transparency to lending rates.
timeline.src: Fund Based Limits; Non Fund Based

timeline.what: Basel II published; consumer credit bureau launched
timeline.why: 3 pillars: capital, supervisory review, market discipline.

timeline.what: PML Records Rules (1 July 2005); BCBS compliance paper (April); SMERA; CRIF incorporated
timeline.why: Record keeping for AML; independent compliance function.

timeline.what: MSMED Act (2 Oct 2006); BC/BF model; UCPDC 600 approved (25 Oct)
timeline.why: Define & support MSMEs; branchless banking; LC rules.
timeline.src: Fund Based; FI; Non Fund Based

timeline.what: UCPDC 600 effective (1 July 2007); CIBIL Score; ICRA listed
timeline.why: All LCs irrevocable; first generic credit score.

timeline.what: LLP Act; RBI circular on CTR (22 May 2008)
timeline.why: Limited liability partnerships; monthly cash transaction reporting.

timeline.what: RBI Note Refund Rules
timeline.why: Rules to exchange soiled and mutilated notes.

timeline.what: Base Rate (01.07.2010); Basel III; CRIF licence; FI Plan Phase I
timeline.why: No lending below Base Rate; stronger capital after 2008 crisis.

timeline.what: Public Procurement Policy for MSEs (1 Apr); EM registration compulsory in TN (01.12.2012)
timeline.why: Assured market for MSEs; protect bank's mortgage.

timeline.what: Aadhaar e-KYC allowed (Sept); Companies Act 2013
timeline.why: Easy account opening; One Person Company introduced.

timeline.what: PMJDY (28 Aug 2014); CRILC created; CRIF takes High Mark
timeline.why: Bank account for every household; data on large credit.

timeline.what: APY (9 May 2015); procurement policy mandatory (1 Apr); LCR 60%
timeline.why: Pension for unorganised sector; liquidity safety.
Faster rate transmission; guarantee for micro loans; transparent Govt buying.

timeline.what: MSME Sambandh (8 Dec 2017); TransUnion buys 92.1% of CIBIL
timeline.why: Monitor Govt procurement from MSEs.

timeline.what: PMJDY open-ended (28.08.2018); MSME Sampark (27.06.2018)
timeline.why: Focus moved to every adult; OD ₹10,000, accident cover ₹2 lakh.

timeline.what: EBLR (01.10.2019); LCR 100% (Jan 2019); VAHAN-CERSAI link (3 May)
timeline.why: Loans linked to external benchmark like Repo.

timeline.what: NSFI 2019-24 released (10 Jan); CHAMPIONS (1 June); Global Tender rule (15 May)
timeline.why: Financial inclusion plan; MSME grievances; Make in India.

timeline.what: BCSBI functions stopped (28.09.2021); street vendors as MSME (9 Aug)
timeline.why: RBI handles it directly; codes still apply.

timeline.what: SDF introduced (April 2022)
timeline.why: Replaced fixed reverse repo as floor of LAF corridor.

timeline.what: PM Vishwakarma (17 Sep 2023); CGTMSE lock-in revised (15 Dec)
timeline.why: Support artisans with loans, toolkit and training.
Clear long pending entries; keep legal action alive.

timeline.what: Revised PSL w.e.f. 01.04.2025; Cyber crime Cir 14 (05.04.2025)
timeline.why: New PSL targets; exports out of MSME turnover; protect customers.

timeline.what: Policy rates as on 5 June 2026: Repo 5.25%, CRR 3%, SLR 18%
timeline.why: Current RBI rates; NSFI 2025-30 aims for 30% women BCs by Dec 2028.
